title: Carry structured errors through a pipeline
description: You can distinguish successful values from parsing and arithmetic error records.

steps.description: Ok applies value transformations and chained functions. Err preserves itself through those operations and provides a separate error transformation.
ParseError, MathError, and IOError_ store different details about failures. These are data records carried by Err.
parse_number and safe_sqrt return Ok or structured Err values. load_number adds a missing-file case but is not called by this demonstration.

steps.question: Does process call safe_sqrt after parsing abc returns Err?
steps.answer: No. Err.and_then preserves the parsing error.

steps.description: The calls display successful square roots alongside parse and math failures. The error's record type remains visible after chaining.
The final match handles Ok, a wrapped ParseError, and a wrapped MathError separately. The supplied run displays one example of each.
